verdict.rationale: A probe shows HubSpot serves agent-oriented markdown versions of its developer docs (a .md page returned HTTP 200), and that page points agents to a documentation index at /docs/llms.txt. However, the root llms.txt returned HTTP 404 and the /docs/llms.txt index itself was never fetched, so coverage is only partial. Missing for 10: a verified, reachable llms.txt (root 404, /docs path unprobed), first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs offering, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent consuming them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/llms.txt
